selected_evidence.requirement: Host key signed by the CA and sshd configured to present it
selected_evidence.summary: ssh-keygen -s signed the ed25519 host key producing ssh_host_ed25519_key-cert.pub; sshd -t passed and ssh service restarted active; ssh-keygen -L confirms cert type, signing CA, and principals

selected_evidence.requirement: Client connects trusting only the CA, without host-key pinning
selected_evidence.summary: ssh with UserKnownHostsFile containing only an @cert-authority line (no pinned host key) shows 'Host ... is known and matches the ED25519-CERT host certificate', authenticates, and runs a command
Captured boot_id 6ab98831-2739-47d3-b99c-0784ebb8b49e, ssh active, HostCertificate directive present, cert file details, CA dir contents
Backgrounded 'sleep 1; reboot' via sudo -n returned REBOOT_TRIGGERED before the node dropped

selected_evidence.requirement: Proof of changed boot identity (actual restart, not just service restart)
selected_evidence.summary: Node briefly refused connections (going down), then came back with boot_id 8bf7baef-e848-4e73-bc71-958016ef3303, differing from the pre-restart boot_id

selected_evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of SSH CA/certificate setup and CA-trust connectivity
selected_evidence.summary: After reboot, sshd still active with HostCertificate configured and serving the same signed certificate; a client trusting only the CA reconnected successfully (CONNECTED_AFTER_REBOOT) confirming end-to-end recovery

commands.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
ssh -V
sudo -n true && echo SUDO_OK
whoami
echo "$NODE_NAME $NODE_IP"

set -Eeuo pipefail

echo "STEP: create CA"
sudo -n mkdir -p /etc/ssh/ca
sudo -n test -f /etc/ssh/ca/ssh_ca || sudo -n ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -f /etc/ssh/ca/ssh_ca -N '' -C "node1-ssh-host-ca"
sudo -n chmod 700 /etc/ssh/ca
sudo -n chmod 600 /etc/ssh/ca/ssh_ca
sudo -n chmod 644 /etc/ssh/ca/ssh_ca.pub

echo "STEP: sign host key"
sudo -n ssh-keygen -s /etc/ssh/ca/ssh_ca -I "node1-host-cert" -h \
  -n "$NODE_NAME,$NODE_IP,localhost" \
  -V +52w \
  /etc/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key.pub
sudo -n chmod 644 /etc/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key-cert.pub

echo "STEP: configure sshd"
sudo -n cp /etc/ssh/sshd_config /etc/ssh/sshd_config.bak.$(date +%s)
if ! grep -q '^HostCertificate /etc/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key-cert.pub' /etc/ssh/sshd_config; then
  printf '\nHostCertificate /etc/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key-cert.pub\n' | sudo -n tee -a /etc/ssh/sshd_config >/dev/null
fi

echo "STEP: test config"
sudo -n sshd -t

echo "STEP: restart sshd"
sudo -n systemctl restart ssh
sleep 1
systemctl is-active ssh

echo "STEP: verify cert served"
ssh-keyscan -t ed25519 "$NODE_IP" 2>/dev/null || true

echo "STEP: cert details"
ssh-keygen -L -f /etc/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key-cert.pub

echo "STEP: client trust test"
mkdir -p ~/.ssh
CA_PUB=$(cat /etc/ssh/ca/ssh_ca.pub)
echo "@cert-authority $NODE_NAME,$NODE_IP,localhost $CA_PUB" > /tmp/known_hosts_ca
ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -o UserKnownHostsFile=/tmp/known_hosts_ca -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=5 "$NODE_IP" 'echo CONNECTED_WITH_CA_TRUST' 2>&1 || true
